metrics.mission_target: Only literal pickup mission 'pick up the {color} {key|ball|box}' and exact public 7x7 object type/color, no key as proxy for mission target
metrics.any_visible: Before-action exact target present anywhere; frames, unique public hashes, exposed episodes
metrics.front: Exact target at public image[3][5]; frames, unique public hashes, exposed episodes
metrics.action_at_front: 7-way selected action histogram conditioned on exact target in front; actual action3 attempts
metrics.effects: Actual before-front target followed by action3 and after-front empty and same heading, separately original goal reward
metrics.door: Locked door in front, toggle selected, real state2 to state0 same object/color and direction; cannot infer key possession
metrics.coverage: Any target visible, target visible but not front, front target but not selected pickup, selected pickup with/without observed effect; no hidden pose/inventory
metrics.cold: Per seed/role/family and action index for each target-front pickup attempt, next original public front; observational only
metrics.control: Retain empirical real action histograms of corrected controls, separate diversity from navigation ability
metrics.crosscheck: Both original process canonical hashes, each episode event hash, each before/after public hash, exact original source per-family role target-front/selected pickup/effect/door-open/positive goal tallies

successor: Inform active separate MG36 prospective model-based development branch only as an explicit retrospective diagnostic; never modify its frozen first-use/seed/science conditions after effects are observed.
